summary: This directory manages the core data access layer by providing standardized CRUD repository interfaces, entity state synchronization mechanisms, and automated field mapping, while ensuring logical correctness through dedicated verification suites.
responsibilities: Synchronize entity states with database records
Derive repository implementations from schema definitions
Verify integrity of data differentiation logic
relationships: Repository interfaces standardize how CRUD operations interact with schema definitions.
Data synchronization logic utilizes entity differentiation to determine necessary state changes between application and database records.
Verification suites validate that entity differentiation logic correctly processes data transformations.
designDecisions: Use of generic interfaces for type-safe data access
Separation of synchronization logic from repository interfaces
Co-location of verification tests with implementation logic
Composition of repository capabilities through interface extension
